description: Welcome to this amazing, remodeled home on a large lot in a highly desirable community. This home has an open floor plan making it perfect for any sized family.The kitchen has been remodeled with new cabinets, Quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and a huge island opening to a spacious living room. Bathrooms have been fully upgraded with exceptional finishes, there is new flooring and paint throughout and a brand new energy-efficient air conditioning unit has been installed. This home has RV access and an oversized garage that has been used as a mother-in-law’s suite in the past
